name: Молоко 2,5%
source: Current Ukrainian retail reference: Яготинське UHT 2.5% 900 g + corroborating standard milk profiles
audit_note: Generic-first identity for ordinary cow milk 2.5%. Current Яготинське 900 g profile is C4.7/P2.8/F2.5/53; other ordinary Ukrainian 2.5% milk profiles cluster closely (e.g. 4.5–4.8 g carbs). Do not create brand duplicates solely for packaging/brand when recipe is ordinary milk. Lactose-free milk is not added as a separate carb identity here because current 2.5% examples also report 4.7 g carbs/100 g; it may later be represented as an attribute/alias if product metadata supports it.

name: Кефір 2,5%
source: Current Ukrainian retail reference: Яготинський кефір 2.5% (multiple package sizes)
audit_note: Generic-first identity for plain kefir 2.5%. Current Яготинський retail cards across 450/850/900 g consistently report C4.0/P3.0/F2.5 and about 50–51 kcal. Галичина plain 2.5% is slightly lower at C3.8, not enough by itself to justify brand proliferation.

name: Ряжанка 4%
source: Current Ukrainian retail references: Яготинська 4% + Галичина 4%
audit_note: Generic-first identity for plain ryazhanka 4%. Current Яготинська package sizes and current manufacturer Галичина profile agree at C3.5/P3.0/F4.0; calorie display varies modestly (62 vs 66) without a carbohydrate conflict. CarbCalc reference retains the repeatedly reported Яготинська 62 kcal profile.
